title: Skill Router Service State
description: Matches free-form text — e.g. a voice transcript — against a configured set of skills with a local LLM and dispatches the matched skill's board with extracted parameters. (Runtimes: python; IDs: skill-router)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

skills.description: Skills as {action, board, payload}; malformed entries are dropped

noMatch.description: stop ends the pipeline; forward passes the input to the services after the router

stream.description: Stream the model output token by token into the UI

serverUrl.description: Server backend: base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server

model.description: Server backend: optional model name passed through to the server

modelPath.description: Local backend: path to the .gguf file (~ expands)

contextSize.description: Local backend: context window in tokens

gpuLayers.description: Local backend: layers to offload to GPU (-1 = all)
